authority_note: This manifest declares required state; it grants no authority. Host topology comes from deploy/oracle/resource-fabric/hosts.json; host classes from agent-system/orchestration/execution-fabric/constants.mjs; canonical installers under deploy/oracle/execution-fabric and deploy/oracle/hermes-codex remain the mechanism. The bootstrap detects, verifies, converges through pinned channels declared in supply-chain/PINS.json, wraps canonical installers only when they satisfy the same supply-chain rule, and never duplicates them. Secrets never appear here (credentials carry references only).
canonical_branch_note: master remains the canonical integration branch (PROJECT_CANONICAL_STATE.json canonical_integration_branch). Owner confirmation is recorded in docs/project-state/authorizations/auth-20260915-owner-development-system-green-closure.json; the branch is not renamed.
protected_master_pin: certification records origin/master at start and fails STALE if HEAD or origin/master moves before the report is sealed
